title: cos(1)'s odd-count partial sums are an upper bracket
statement: For every m, cosOne <= sumRange cosTerm (succ(m+m)) -- the mirror of CReal.cosOne_alternating_lower, off CReal.alternatingUpperBound (this batch).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.cosOne_alternating_upper : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal.le CReal.cosOne (CReal.sumRange CReal.cosTerm (AxNat.succ (AxNat.add x0 x0))))

evidence.supports: CReal.cosOne_alternating_upper is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
